annotations.title: Tell Ploa's team what it doesn't cover

description: Writes down for Ploa's own team something Ploa doesn't do or got wrong, that this work ran into: a store form it doesn't fill, a check that fired for nothing, a step that had to be done by hand. Say what happened, what was done instead, and what would fix it. It goes to Ploa's operators, not to the person, and doesn't ask anyone; use it instead of quietly working around a gap. Nothing secret: no keys, passwords or customers' data. A few a day per workspace.

details.description: What happened, what was done instead, and what would fix it (up to 8000 characters).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

title.description: One line: what Ploa doesn't do (up to 200 characters).

name: ploa_gap_report
